title: Upper Flint 2024 published nonurban NDR and SDR reference profiles

citation.title: The Impact of Projected Land Use Changes on the Availability of Ecosystem Services in the Upper Flint River Watershed, USA

extraction.source_representation: Complete author-published supplement text, Tables S2 andS3 plus their adjacent factor and subsurface definitions.

load_type_choice.basis: Compatibility adaptation: use each published loading coefficient directly without an additional on-pixel retention multiplication. This field is added for the current native schema; it is absent from the original table.

native_mapping.design: Each one-level factorial specification preserves a coherent source alternative and includes the original baseline.
native_mapping.baseline_row_policy: The existing profile supplies water, developed and emergent herbaceous wetland rows while the listed nonurban mappings use the published alternative.
native_mapping.water_length: Original Table S3 prints critical lengths 0 for water. Its original record is retained in the publication CSV; the active water row comes from the receiving baseline.
native_mapping.urban_mapping: The supplement's five imperviousness labels have no retrieved numerical bin thresholds. The original values remain in published-biophysical.csv for the exact source mapping.
native_mapping.model_arguments: The receiving baseline retains its routing and algorithm parameters. This data addition sets tabular coefficients only.
